adaptations: Full original MIT header retained in adapted done.fish; humanize_duration body unchanged.
Linux notify-send invocation, duration gate and success/failure semantics adapted from pinned fish_postexec handler.
Independent namespace guard; no automatic startup, focus probes, terminal escape notification, Windows/macOS helpers, eval override or upstream uninstall event.
Default body omits commands and working directories. Optional command text is bounded and XML-escaped.
Explicit current-shell single-process background watcher uses Fish on-process-exit, elapsed from registration; rejects multi-process/pipeline jobs; no all-shell job discovery.
Notification transport bounded by coreutils timeout (2s plus 1s kill grace).

Pkgrel2: timeout --foreground keeps monitor alive to reap the named single-process notify-send after forced kill. Bound remains2s+1s grace; arbitrary descendants are not covered. Proven by isolated host child-subreaper probe; native lifecycle retry remains required.
